methodology.mapping: square GEMMs tiled across M, K, and N onto N x N INT8 systolic arrays
methodology.cycle_model: steady-state compute-core projection; one full N x N x N tile contributes N compute cycles
methodology.latency_claim: analytical compute-core projection, not measured end-to-end model latency
methodology.power_claim: energy values are vectorless-power proxies at each design's closed target clock, not workload-activity-qualified energy
